Image inside a link produces a linked image

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<a href=\"https://example.com\"><img src=\"logo.png\" alt=\"Logo\"></a>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result);
```
